title: Key West Sushi and Sunset Cruise
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a Spectacular Key West Sunset Cruise

Looking for the perfect way to end your day? Join us on the Seabreeze, your 42-foot Corinthian powercat, and ride in comfort with this relaxing, catered cruise into the horizon on Key West’s gentle seas. Relax in the shade under the bimini or sunbathe on the bow to take in that last bit of sunshine. Sunset Cruises are a Key West luxury with your panoramic views of the sun melting into tropical waters – and the best way to enjoy is with good food and great drinks!

Enjoy elevated hors d’oeurvres without the price tag – a typical selection includes fresh sushi, Thai appetizers, charcuterie platter (meats and cheeses), and French desserts catered by locally owned and operated restaurants. Refreshments include your complimentary selection of fine wine, premium beer, Prosecco, and soft drinks.

Departure times vary with the seasons, please confirm your departure time when booking this trip.
